scope: Closed-domain, range, spectral-gap and Hodge-cohomology theorem for the K1297 orbit Witten complex and its Weyl-invariant sector.

theorem.single_summand_spectrum: sum_i 2 mu_i (n_i+epsilon_i), with n_i nonnegative integers and epsilon_i in {0,1}
theorem.common_graph_domain: D_common=D((1+L)^2), complete in norm ||(1+L)^2 u|| and contained in every domain needed for d_Phi,d_Phi^*,L,d_Phi L,L d_Phi
theorem.smooth_core: orbit-sum Schwartz forms are a common invariant core
theorem.hodge_decomposition: H=ker L orthogonal_sum closure(im d_Phi) orthogonal_sum closure(im d_Phi^*)
theorem.cohomology_pairing: ambient L2 pairing restricted to the one-dimensional invariant Gaussian class

claim_ceiling: Exact functional-analysis control for the repository Witten lift. Its gap and cohomology do not identify a source state space, constraint quotient or physical inner product.
